sentences.japanese: 明日は来なくてもいいです。
sentences.english: You don't have to come tomorrow.

sentences.japanese: そんなに急がなくてもいいよ。
sentences.english: You don't have to hurry that much.

sentences.japanese: 心配しなくてもいいです。
sentences.english: You don't have to worry.

sentences.japanese: 野菜を食べなくてもいいです。
sentences.english: You don't have to eat the vegetables.

sentences.japanese: 新しい本を買わなくてもいいです。
sentences.english: You don't have to buy a new book.

sentences.japanese: その水を飲まなくてもいいです。
sentences.english: You don't have to drink that water.

sentences.japanese: この新聞を読まなくてもいいですか。
sentences.english: Is it okay if I don't read this newspaper?

sentences.japanese: 今日は学校へ行かなくてもかまわない。
sentences.english: It's fine if you don't go to school today.

alternates.japanese: 今日は学校に行かなくてもかまわない。
今日は学校へ行かなくてもいい。

sentences.japanese: 暖かいですから、窓を閉めなくてもいいですよ。
sentences.english: It's warm, so you don't have to close the window.

sentences.japanese: この紙に書かなくてもいいです。
sentences.english: You don't have to write on this paper.

sentences.japanese: 週末は本を読んだり、映画を見たりします。
sentences.english: On weekends I do things like read books and watch movies.

sentences.japanese: 食べたり飲んだりしました。
sentences.english: We ate, drank, and so on.

sentences.japanese: 明日、町へ行ったり、服を買ったりします。
sentences.english: Tomorrow I'll do things like go into town and buy clothes.

sentences.japanese: 昨日は、家で寝たりしました。
sentences.english: Yesterday I did things like sleep at home.

sentences.japanese: 公園で遊んだり、弁当を食べたりしました。
sentences.english: We played in the park, ate boxed lunches, and so on.

sentences.japanese: 図書館では話したり、電話を使ったりしません。
sentences.english: In the library, I don't talk, use my phone, or anything like that.

sentences.japanese: 夏は海で遊んだり、山へ行ったりしますか。
sentences.english: In summer, do you do things like play at the sea and go to the mountains?

sentences.japanese: うちの猫は、毎日寝たり食べたりしています。
sentences.english: Every day our cat just sleeps, eats, and so on.

sentences.japanese: 父はいつも新聞を読んだり、コーヒーを飲んだりしています。
sentences.english: My father is always reading the newspaper, drinking coffee, and so on.

sentences.japanese: 新しい車がほしいです。
sentences.english: I want a new car.

sentences.japanese: お金がほしい。
sentences.english: I want money.

sentences.japanese: 時間がほしいです。
sentences.english: I want more time.

sentences.japanese: 水がほしいです。
sentences.english: I want water.

sentences.japanese: 古い服はほしくないです。
sentences.english: I don't want old clothes.

sentences.japanese: 去年、カメラがほしかったです。
sentences.english: Last year, I wanted a camera.

sentences.japanese: パソコンがほしいです。
sentences.english: I want a computer.

sentences.japanese: あなたは何がほしいですか。
sentences.english: What do you want?

alternates.japanese: 何がほしいですか。

sentences.japanese: 私は大きい犬がほしいです。
sentences.english: I want a big dog.

alternates.japanese: 大きい犬がほしいです。

sentences.japanese: 冬は暖かいコートがほしいです。
sentences.english: In winter, I want a warm coat.

sentences.japanese: 授業の前に本を読みます。
sentences.english: I read a book before class.

alternates.japanese: 授業の後で本を読みます。

sentences.japanese: 食べる前に手を洗う。
sentences.english: I wash my hands before eating.

sentences.japanese: 晩ご飯の前にテレビを見る。
sentences.english: I watch TV before dinner.

alternates.japanese: 晩ご飯の後でテレビを見る。

sentences.japanese: 寝る前に本を読んだ。
sentences.english: I read a book before going to sleep.

sentences.japanese: 友達が来る前に、部屋を出る。
sentences.english: I leave the room before my friend comes.

sentences.japanese: 学校へ行く前に、何を食べますか。
sentences.english: What do you eat before you go to school?

alternates.japanese: 学校に行く前に、何を食べますか。

sentences.japanese: 映画の前に、お手洗いへ行きます。
sentences.english: I go to the restroom before the movie.

alternates.japanese: 映画の前に、お手洗いに行きます。

sentences.japanese: 朝ご飯の前にコーヒーは飲みません。
sentences.english: I don't drink coffee before breakfast.

sentences.japanese: 先生が来る前に、椅子に座りましょう。
sentences.english: Let's sit down before the teacher comes.

sentences.japanese: 食べた後で、コーヒーを飲みます。
sentences.english: After eating, I drink coffee.

alternates.japanese: 食べたあとで、コーヒーを飲みます。

sentences.japanese: 授業の後で、遊びます。
sentences.english: After class, I play.

alternates.japanese: 授業の前に、遊びます。

sentences.japanese: 仕事の後で、映画を見ます。
sentences.english: After work, I watch a movie.

sentences.japanese: 仕事の後で、電話します。
sentences.english: I'll call after work.

sentences.japanese: 授業の後で、映画を見ます。
sentences.english: After class, I'll watch a movie.

sentences.japanese: ご飯を食べた後で、お茶を飲みます。
sentences.english: After eating a meal, I drink tea.

sentences.japanese: 本を読んだ後で、寝ました。
sentences.english: After I read a book, I went to sleep.

sentences.japanese: 映画を見たあとで、ご飯を食べます。
sentences.english: After watching a movie, I'll eat.

sentences.japanese: 授業の後で、何をしますか。
sentences.english: What are you doing after class?

sentences.japanese: 晩ご飯の後で、お菓子は食べません。
sentences.english: I don't eat sweets after dinner.

sentences.japanese: 日本へ行きたいです。
sentences.english: I want to go to Japan.

sentences.japanese: 水が飲みたいです。
sentences.english: I want to drink water.

sentences.japanese: 今日は何も食べたくない。
sentences.english: I don't want to eat anything today.

sentences.japanese: 今日は会社へ行きたくないです。
sentences.english: I don't want to go to the office today.

sentences.japanese: 昨日、あの本を買いたかったです。
sentences.english: Yesterday, I wanted to buy that book.

sentences.japanese: 週末は寝たいです。
sentences.english: On the weekend, I want to sleep.

sentences.japanese: 晩ご飯は何が食べたいですか。
sentences.english: What do you want to eat for dinner?

sentences.japanese: 母に手紙を書きたいです。
sentences.english: I want to write a letter to my mother.

sentences.japanese: 今は誰にも会いたくないです。
sentences.english: Right now, I don't want to see anyone.

sentences.japanese: 犬と公園で遊びたいです。
sentences.english: I want to play in the park with my dog.

sentences.japanese: 映画を見に行きます。
sentences.english: I'm going to see a movie.

sentences.japanese: 本を買いに行きました。
sentences.english: I went to buy a book.

sentences.japanese: 友達に会いに来ました。
sentences.english: I came to see a friend.

sentences.japanese: 友達がうちへ遊びに来る。
sentences.english: A friend is coming over to my place to hang out.

sentences.japanese: 妹は毎晩、晩ご飯を食べに帰る。
sentences.english: Every night, my younger sister comes home to eat dinner.

sentences.japanese: 毎日、学校へ勉強しに行く。
sentences.english: Every day, I go to school to study.

sentences.japanese: レストランへおいしいご飯を食べに行く。
sentences.english: I'm going to a restaurant to eat good food.

sentences.japanese: 週末、どこへ遊びに行きますか。
sentences.english: Where are you going to hang out this weekend?

sentences.japanese: 海へ泳ぎに行きました。
sentences.english: I went to the sea to swim.

sentences.japanese: 子供のとき、よく遊びました。
sentences.english: When I was a child, I played a lot.

alternates.japanese: 子供の時、よく遊びました。

sentences.japanese: 暇なとき、本を読みます。
sentences.english: When I'm free, I read books.

sentences.japanese: バスを降りるとき、傘を忘れました。
sentences.english: When I got off the bus, I forgot my umbrella.

sentences.japanese: 子供の時、野菜が嫌いでした。
sentences.english: As a child, I hated vegetables.

sentences.japanese: 暇な時、何をしますか。
sentences.english: What do you do when you're free?

sentences.japanese: 暑い時、冷たい水を飲みます。
sentences.english: On hot days, I drink cold water.

sentences.japanese: 家へ帰る時、パンを買いました。
sentences.english: On the way home, I bought bread.

alternates.japanese: 家に帰る時、パンを買いました。
家へ帰る前に、パンを買いました。

sentences.japanese: 家へ帰った時、テレビを見ました。
sentences.english: When I got home, I watched TV.

sentences.japanese: 道を渡るとき、携帯は見ません。
sentences.english: When I cross the road, I don't look at my phone.
